name: Sign in and load a persistent demo account
description: Verifies a customer can authenticate and load their own stored GenZ Bank demo account.
steps: Wait for the customer overview to load
expected: The authenticated customer sees a personalized overview, a demo balance in NPR, account activity, and the simulated-environment disclosure.

name: Record a demo deposit and export account activity
description: Verifies a successful simulated deposit updates the displayed balance and ledger and can be exported.
steps: Sign in to a demo account
Choose Demo deposit and enter NPR 500
expected: The balance increases by NPR 500, a completed demo transaction with a reference appears, and a CSV statement downloads.

name: Reject an invalid or over-balance withdrawal
description: Verifies invalid money movement requests are rejected by the backend and do not produce a success receipt.
steps: Sign in to a demo account
Choose Demo withdrawal and enter an amount greater than the available demo balance
expected: An insufficient demo balance message appears and the stored account balance remains unchanged.

name: Create a savings goal and use mobile navigation
description: Verifies goal creation is visible after saving and key navigation works on a mobile viewport.
steps: Sign in on a mobile viewport
Open navigation and choose Savings goals
Create a goal named First Laptop with a target of NPR 50000
Refresh the page and return to Savings goals
expected: The new goal remains visible after refresh, navigation remains usable on mobile, and the page has no horizontal overflow.
